optimizedContext.value:
# SQLite Graph Store

## Rules

- `SQLiteGraphStore` implements `GraphStore`; backend id `sqlite`; default when `graphStoreId` omitted.
- Open/close: defer native bindings until `open()`; `close()` idempotent; initializes DDL/versioning on first open.
- Storage paths: database/WAL under `{configPath}/graph`, temporary scratch under `{configPath}/tmp`.
- Schema: tables for `File`, `Symbol`, `Spec`, `Document`, `Meta`, and relations `IMPORTS`, `DEFINES`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXPORTS`, `DEPENDS_ON`, `COVERS_FILE`, `COVERS_SYMBOL`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES`. `COVERS_SYMBOL` preserves stale metadata.
- FTS5 virtual tables: `symbol_fts` (`name`, `comment`), `spec_fts` (`title`, `description`, `content`), `document_fts` (`path`, `content`), trigram source content index for queries ≥ 3 chars.
- Query processing: sanitize multi-token queries with `OR`; supplement FTS candidates with identity hits.
- SQL ranking: exact canonical identity > exact token > prefix > suffix > real component > substring > BM25 body text. Never replace FTS with plain `LIKE`.
- Transactions: `upsertFile`, `removeFile`, `upsertSpec`, `removeSpec`, bulk commits are atomic transactions.
- Bulk indexing: single transaction, set-based endpoint validation, prepared/bulk inserts, commit once, rebuild FTS once post-commit. Scratch in `{configPath}/tmp` cleaned post-run.
- Schema versioning: tracks backend schema version; incompatible versions reject reads and require `recreate()` full rebuild, `storage.epoch` rotation, and FTS rebuild.
- Observations: persists `IndexedInputObservation` records and workspace/global latches for incremental hydration.

## Constraints

- Infrastructure adapter; consumers depend on abstract `code-graph:graph-store`.
- Backend id `sqlite`.
- All persisted artifacts rooted under `configPath`.
